subject: Stage curation timeline & leadership deliverables
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage curation timeline & leadership deliverables

Team —

Quick heads up: finance has asked for a tighter audit of stage-level commits ahead of the QBR readout. I want us to run a focused curation window this week so Leadership has a clean exec pack by end of next week. Key asks below:  

1) By EOD Friday (10/29) — owners should update stage_flags in the attached CSV (column guidance in the header). If a deal is being counted as a commit, add the rationale column (one sentence).
2) By Tue 11/02 — management handoff: managers to validate top 10 commits for their stage and confirm expected close month.
3) By Thu 11/04 — exec pack submission: Markus to consolidate and circulate the deck for review; Leadership readout rehearsal Fri 11/05.

Please use the stage_updates_template.csv attached and drop any supporting docs to the Drive folder below. If you anticipate blockers to the Friday deadline, flag immediately so we can triage.

Attachments: stage_updates_template.csv (CSV)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-exec-pack-2026Q4

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Kim — taking point for ARR motion. I'll push a calendar invite for a short 30-min triage this afternoon (3:00 PM PT) so owners can surface edge cases (multi-booked opportunities, cross-region split). Marcus and I will prepare a shortlist of deals we think need leadership attention before Markus assembles the pack.

Quick note: Acme has a PO in progress but procurement asked for a one-week extension on terms — I cc'd their procurement contact to keep them in the loop on timing.

—Laura
Laura Bennett

Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 12:30:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage curation timeline & leadership deliverables

Thanks — noted. A couple operational points from my side:  

- I'll take point on compiling the exec pack slides. Please follow the naming convention in the exec_pack_instructions.pdf (attached).
- If teams are going to change commit status after Friday, call it out in the rationale column and mark the row "post-lock exception" so we can trace changes.
- I'll need final slide inputs (top 10 by ARR impact) by Tue 11/02 10:00 AM PT to leave time for formatting and QA.

Also attaching a short checklist for the leadership readout: leadership_readout_agenda.docx (DOCX). We'll run the rehearsal Fri 11/05 at 11:00 AM PT — tentative calendar invite to follow.

Attachments: exec_pack_instructions.pdf (PDF), leadership_readout_agenda.docx (DOCX)

-Markus

Head of GTM Operations

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 17:02:08 -0700
Subject: RE: Stage curation timeline & leadership deliverables

Forwarding final checklist and confirming next steps.

Team —

Thanks all for the quick turnaround today. Summary and actions:  

• Laura — thanks for scheduling the 3:00 PM triage; captured edge cases and updated the Drive folder with the shortlist (file: acme_edge_cases_notes.md).
• Owners — please ensure stage_updates_template.csv is updated by EOD Friday 10/29. I pulled preliminary flags and there are ~14 rows that need explicit rationale entries.
• Markus — confirmed: I'll deliver the top 10 slide inputs by Tue 11/02 09:30 AM PT to give you extra buffer.
• Kimberly — can you confirm whether Finance needs any separate CSV export for audit (ARR movement log)? If so we'll include it in the Drive.

Natalie / Acme procurement — looping you in so expectations are aligned on timeline. If the PO timing slides, we'll note that as a potential commit drift in the exec pack.

Attachments referenced: stage_updates_template.csv, exec_pack_instructions.pdf, leadership_readout_agenda.docx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-exec-pack-2026Q4

—Monica
